projects.title: Gaia
projects.description: Gaia began as a personal exploration of two things I love: the outdoors and the community of people who share what they find there. I rebranded and redesigned iNaturalist, the world’s largest biodiversity platform, to turn a tool built for experts into an open invitation for anyone curious about nature. I scaled one identity into a complete visual system of logotype, color, typography, and icons, then extended the system across print, out of home, digital, and interactive pieces. I worked alone at every stage, from strategy and identity to a working iOS app I built in SwiftUI.

projects.title: AirPods Pro 3
projects.description: As a design intern on Apple’s Marcom Identity team, I worked on the AirPods Pro 3 launch, where one identity system had to hold across the keynote, Apple Retail, the web, and partner channels. I focused on hardware lighting, image making, and product angle lockups, plus feature and typography animations for motion. The role taught me to design within a large team, present work to stakeholders across marketing, and refine every asset through their feedback.

projects.title: Peak Energy
projects.description: Peak Energy builds sodium-ion batteries, a domestic alternative to lithium and a technology at the center of the next energy shift. This brand film announced the company's partnership with General Motors. It places sodium-ion on the timeline of human energy and frames Peak Energy as a leader in the next phase of power. I led the central animation sequence, developing the storyboards, directing the visual language, and building a precise line-based system that could carry both abstract concepts and product detail.

projects.title: Motion Connect 2025
projects.description: Motion Connect is an ArtCenter talk series bringing the motion design community together, with 2025 speakers from Apple TV, Hornet, and Brand New School. I based the identity on 1980s arcade graphics: bitmap glow, scanlines, and the boot-up energy of a machine powering on. From those cues, I built a brand system and carried the system across the motion reel, social media, and print, so every piece reads as part of one season.

projects.title: Simon & Schuster
projects.description: In 2022, the Justice Department blocked Penguin Random House from buying Simon & Schuster, preserving one of the last independently owned Big Five publishers. Most coverage framed the ruling as a near miss, but I saw a positioning opportunity: independence as the asset, not the consolation prize. I grounded this self-initiated rebrand in real market data and focused my work on the visual result: an identity system spanning print, event design, digital, and social media.

projects.title: National Park Playing Cards
projects.description: National Park Playing Cards started as my tribute to U.S. national parks and grew into a business I still run, with 20,000+ decks sold. The decks sell in 220+ stores nationwide, including REI and six national park visitor centers. I designed the full product system: cards, box, brand, and storefront. I also funded the launch on Kickstarter, built the business, and pitched retailers myself.
